scope: Two genuine-provider AMD64 runtime diagnostic commands under ARM-host emulation, differing only in documented JIT memory mapping. No product/runtime/fixture patch or production acceptance.

variants.name: baseline
variants.purpose: Same genuine failing donor version probe; retain bounded crash dump.

variants.name: jit-single
variants.program:
set -eu
version=28.5.0.8
actual=$(erl +JMsingle true -noshell -eval '{ok,B}=file:read_file(filename:join([code:root_dir(),"releases",erlang:system_info(otp_release),"OTP_VERSION"])), io:put_chars(string:trim(binary_to_list(B))), halt(0).')
[ "$actual" = "$version" ]
printf '%s\n' "$actual"
variants.purpose: Only add documented +JMsingle true VM-mapping flag; keep exact OTP_VERSION eval/comparison and all other arguments/env/limits unchanged.

interpretation: Prior actual dump proves prim_tty:tty_create/1 executes erlang:nif_error(undef); upstream issue9877 reports exactly that stack on ARM-Mac AMD-container translation and recommends +JMsingle true. Official OTP28 docs explain single vsdual JIT mappings. Actual local causal workaround remains UNPROVED until this control completes; provider success alone is not common-context/full-Elixir acceptance. No persistent customer/runtime ENV change.

pull_policy: Exactly one LinuxDocker pull command in one cached-Alpine helper with empty own config. No retry/mirror/auth. Newly pulled exact image retained for later context probe; no image/layer prune. Metadata compressed size is exact; local unpacked space is unknown before pull and postchecked <=1GiB, not a reservation. Global8GiB floor observed during clients.
hold_policy: After successful one-pull/actualconfig check, claim/create a labeled networknone/readOnly provider hold container and prove statecreated/PID0. Never start it. Keep its CID/image reference through both unchanged-oracle diagnostics; exact existing finally cleanup removes it. Max2 containers at once (hold+one diagnostic); pull helper is already removed. No unrelated cache/image cleanup.
